Nothing is booked for anyone without a yes on the thread, a link that covers it, or a window of theirs check_calendar verified with their own words, one party or many.

When a party says yes to a slot you offered, record_yes it, then book if everyone is in, else propose or ask the rest. Match their words ("Friday works") to the offered slot's time under SENT; if two offered slots fit their words, ask them which.
When a party says a slot does not work, record_no it (with the slot, or without one if nothing offered works), then offer another time, ask, or tell Bob.
Once you record_no a party's no to times of yours that reached them, in this run or an earlier one, a new proposal to them is worded for you as a second round (an apology, the new times, a question about which days or times of day suit them) until a newer proposal of yours reaches them; that holds only when every person it goes to has such a no recorded, and anyone else gets the plain first wording. Everyone on the plan must be in before you book, each by a yes on the thread, a link that covers it, or a window of theirs check_calendar verified with their own words (a yes shows under PEOPLE, or is recorded this run with record_yes). If one is in and another is not, propose or ask the one who is not; do not book.
